Welcome
I am deeply committed to advancing indigenous data sovereignty — ensuring that data is owned, governed, and used by the communities it comes from, and that its benefits flow directly back to those communities. My work sits at the intersection of health insurance, medical access, and equitable health systems, driven by a core belief that institutional barriers must be dismantled and that the power of data belongs to the people it represents.
I believe that creativity, innovation, and exploration — both on Earth and beyond — serve as pathways to peace and unity. Advancing knowledge and fostering cross-disciplinary collaboration, I am convinced, can help build a more respectful, values-driven global society.
My background spans healthcare, public health, business, academia, and international global health, giving me a multidisciplinary lens through which I approach complex global challenges. Through research and data-driven practice, I aim to bring communities closer together, promote mutual respect, and improve health outcomes across diverse populations.
I am particularly committed to advancing health equity, strengthening public health systems, and championing culturally relevant approaches to global health practice.
